channel.title: Natural World
channel.desc: Seals, parakeets and even pelicans that eat pigeons have all made London their home. That's as well as badgers, foxes, scorpions, and pigeons that ride the tube. Even more wonderful are the people who love the exotic wildlife of our capital, from Billingsgate fish porters to Indian Chefs and `Crayfish Bob', who scours London's canals for Turkish invaders.
